sha_pinned_by: git rev-parse HEAD at run time; committing this file advances the head, so verify with 'git diff <this sha> HEAD -- convex/' returning empty rather than expecting the two to match
instrument_note: Counts below are this build's scale. A published build reads different absolutes on the same tree — the reviewer measures 20/17/13/7 where this reads 27/10/17. Neither is wrong; they are two scales. Only a delta measured on ONE instrument on both sides is comparable, which is what is recorded here.
note: Both figures were RUN, the base by checking out origin/main's convex/ and scoring it with the same binary in the same session. The previous evidence file in this repository claimed a zero delta while copying its baseline from an earlier head, and was corrected; this one records both counts and both R-20 site counts so the claim can be refuted rather than believed.
